item.title: [News] Voltage-Controlled Photonic Chip Could Make Smart-Glasses Displays More Efficient
item.description: Smart glasses need compact, efficient displays that can produce detailed images without drawing too much power. Laser beam scanning is one approach to meeting these requirements. Rather than using a fixed array of pixels, these displays steer a laser beam across the field of view, building an image point by point. item.title: Sapphire-grown semiconductor film sets bandgap record
item.description: Semiconductors with wider bandgaps could pave the way for smaller, more efficient electronics that can handle far higher voltages, but the wider this gap becomes, the harder it is to control how well a material conducts electricity. Now, a team led by Darrell Schlom at Cornell University has shown that adding silicon to thin films of aluminum gallium oxide can keep this control intact at bandgaps wider than any semiconductor before it. Their research has been published in Nature.

item.description: 据报道，英特尔已获得微软的一笔重要订单。微软或将采用英特尔代工的18A或18A-P工艺为其制造下一代AI处理器。这是英特尔代工在18A节点上首次确认的重大外部客户订单。

item.title: A lensless chip films gigapixel video
item.description: By coding light at the sensor and learning the correlations in a moving scene, a single lensless chip records gigapixel video at a throughput of 20.8 billion pixels per second.
